spec_contradictions.title: Overall coverage metric is internally inconsistent
evidence: spec.md:265 requires overall statement/line coverage >95%
acceptance.md:306 and interfaces.md:22 require coverage.json totals.percent_covered >95.0
production-file-inventory.json:14 records percent_covered=65.52998152678616 while :18 records percent_statements_covered=68.98003444536582
test-plan.md:63 enables --cov-branch
spec_contradictions.impact: With branch measurement, totals.percent_covered is not the statement/line metric; a run can satisfy the stated DoD and fail the executable gate.
spec_contradictions.user_decision: Choose statement/line or combined coverage as the release metric, then align the NFR, AC, checker and evidence schema.

spec_contradictions.title: Pinned open RW registry cannot also be the closed exit registry
evidence: acceptance.md:132 pins devon-work-items.json and requires 196 unique open RW items
acceptance.md:243 says a registry-hash change fails
spec.md:144-145 requires every RW to close or validly supersede before DoD
interfaces.md:92-111 mandates rw_registry.py close mutate the pinned registry
interfaces.md:221 requires 196 RW to be closed/superseded
devon-work-items.json:4-7 declares status=open and 196/196 bindings
spec_contradictions.impact: Closing any item changes the exact pinned bytes; retaining the bytes leaves all 196 work items open. A PASS package is impossible.
spec_contradictions.user_decision: Define an immutable planning baseline plus a separately versioned runtime registry, or define an approved repin/version-transition rule.

spec_contradictions.title: Pinned decision artifacts contradict the locked no-waiver and semantic-closure claims
evidence: spec.md:29 says all 55 Sage semantic candidates are closed; spec.md:238-241 and coverage-waivers.json:5 require an empty, schema-valid waiver registry
aaron-decisions.md:5-27 records AD-07 Protocol-waive for three retained Protocol files outside coverage-waivers.json
production-file-inventory.json:127-185 labels 55 Sage candidates review-required/undecided
coverage-closure.json:109 says release remains blocked on the 55 undecided candidates
spec_contradictions.impact: The fixed inputs simultaneously declare candidates closed and release-blocking, and introduce a waiver mechanism prohibited by the locked waiver contract.
spec_contradictions.user_decision: Decide whether AD-07 and the 55 pending statuses are stale history or live release facts; version/repin the authoritative artifacts accordingly.

implementation_gaps.title: Classification file is not acceptable same-run evidence
evidence: coverage-file-classification.json:5 names /tmp/cov-full.json and has no commit, run ID, canonical command, pytest exit, or test summary
coverage-file-classification.json:406-414 reports quantide/core/utils.py as missing-from-coverage while assigning 100% and passes_threshold=true
spec.md:64-66 treats a missing executable coverage record as a blocker
interfaces.md:38-42 requires canonical exit-0 coverage input and run provenance
implementation_gaps.required_fix: Regenerate the classification and all release evidence from one canonical exit-0 invocation; a missing coverage row must fail rather than pass.

implementation_gaps.title: Current closure is diagnostic FAIL, not release evidence
evidence: coverage-closure.json:3-7 says NOT_CLOSED, full suite prohibited/not run, CI failure, and 65.52998152678616 diagnostic overall
coverage-closure.json:21-94 lists 64 below-target files and four v0.2-added below 95
coverage-closure.json:359-363 records 196 open RW items
spec.md:251-255 requires all PASS signals and blockers=0
implementation_gaps.required_fix: Complete the required repairs and emit one green canonical evidence package; historical failed coverage cannot be accepted.

tooling_gaps.title: No executable isolated E2E command/evidence contract for traced E2E work
evidence: interfaces.md:19 defines only tests/unit as the canonical command
devon-work-items.json:12-16 and :84-88 bind RW items to tests/e2e modules
test-plan.md:135 requires isolated Green for bound tests/e2e functions but supplies no command or evidence schema for it
tooling_gaps.required_fix: Add a deterministic offline E2E invocation and evidence fields (or formally limit the E2E requirement to trace/audit only); it must preserve the unit-only canonical coverage rule.

gateway_reason: A real qmt gateway is prohibited for the release gate: spec.md:289 and acceptance.md:345 require an isolated suite with no real network/gateway, while test-plan.md:52 and :131 require protocol stubs and forbid real gateway use. The specified HTTP/protocol fixtures plus isolated existing E2E tests can cover the user journeys; real-gateway results may not substitute for release-gate evidence.
recommended_next_step: Obtain user decisions for SC-01 through SC-03, version the affected locked artifacts/contracts, then implement TG-01 and regenerate all gate evidence from one green canonical run without waiver or --force.
